review_notes: No login. Four favorites and keypad are free. Add contacts manually or through the system picker. Phone calls hand off to tel: and answering/ending is handled by iOS. No default-dialer entitlement, call blocking, call recording or automatic dialing. Extras have an explicitly started 14-day trial using the verified original purchase date of the free non-consumable com.appsbybros.easycall.trial14, named 14-day Trial (not a subscription; no renewal or automatic charge). Purchase ID: com.appsbybros.easycall.lifetime. Existing saved people remain callable after preview expiry. On iPad, supported FaceTime Audio is available; carrier calls require a capable phone. Notification permission is requested only when saving a reminder.
